title: Temporal-centroid modulation of optical pulses: inconclusive incremental respiratory-rate accuracy in two public cohorts
abstract: Adding beat-normalized PPG temporal-centroid modulation to five-modulation spectral pooling did not establish incremental respiratory-rate accuracy: equal-record paired MAE reductions were 0.0643 breaths/min (95% record-bootstrap CI -0.1841 to 0.3373) in BIDMC and 0.0773 (-0.2153 to 0.4728) in independent CapnoBase. Both intervals include zero; this is not equivalence or absence of respiratory information. Fixed unfitted algorithms were tested on 53 adult ICU and42 independent adult/pediatric perioperative records. Both datasets were previously exposed; this is exploratory external transport, not untouched confirmation. No clinical utility or causal mechanism is demonstrated.
